title: Go inside the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max!
gist: Promotional notice for an October 14 TechInsights webinar giving preliminary teardown findings on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including the A20 Pro processor, Apple C2 modem, packaging, suppliers and early device costing.

insights.claim: TechInsights will present preliminary Quick Turn Teardown findings on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max on October 14, combining reverse engineering, component identification, early device costing and market intelligence.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Teardown-based bill-of-materials data informs supplier content and Apple margin estimates.

insights.claim: The iPhone 18 Pro models feature Apple's A20 Pro processor and Apple C2 modem, with evolving camera and RF architectures.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: An in-house Apple C2 modem signals continued insourcing away from third-party modem suppliers.
insights.quote: Explore the A20 Pro processor, Apple C2 modem, evolving camera and RF architectures

insights.claim: The teardown will cover memory and storage configurations, semiconductor packaging, thermal management and supplier choices inside Apple's newest Pro models.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Supplier wins or losses in the iPhone 18 Pro will move component vendors.
